Fusionality | Multiple Positions (Controls, SciML, Data Engineering) | Lausanne, CH | ONSITE

Fusionality builds integrated operations technology for fusion devices, spanning real-time diagnostics, control, actuators, data systems, and simulation. Built on decades of operational experience at the Swiss Plasma Center at EPFL, we help fusion teams run their machines more safely, reliably, and efficiently through combined physics, software, hardware, and control expertise.

* Senior Control Systems Engineer

* Computational Scientist / Scientific Machine Learning

* Data/ML engineer, fusion data

Learn more & apply at: https://fusionality.com/careers/
